name: Zaire

flag.description: A green field with a yellow disc in the centre, in which a brown arm and hand hold up a torch with a red flame.
flag.symbolism: The torch was the emblem of the Popular Movement of the Revolution, the ruling and only legal party under Mobutu Sese Seko.

hook: Mobutu's Zaire flew a green flag with a yellow disc where a hand raises a flaming torch; the Congo it became flies sky blue with a red diagonal.
trivia: Mobutu also renamed the Congo River the Zaire River, and the national currency was called the zaire.
When Laurent-Désiré Kabila's forces took Kinshasa in 1997, the country became the Democratic Republic of the Congo again.
